# Futurum Careers

> A platform exploring innovative research, social equity, and community-driven solutions across music, caregiving, and STEM education.

Futurum Careers features thought leadership and research initiatives focused on fostering diversity, inclusion, and equity in professional and educational sectors. The site highlights work from Canadian institutions, Indigenous perspectives, and youth advocacy programs that address systemic challenges through participatory research and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Ethnomusicology research
- Diversity and inclusion
- Indigenous reconciliation
- Music industry equity
- Young carers and caregiving
- Youth advocacy
- STEM education
- Community music practices
- Social innovation
- Participatory research
- Mental health support
- Community leadership
- Decolonization
- Cape Breton University
- Scientix STEM Discovery

## Music, Culture & Equity

- [How can innovative ethnomusicology research help foster diversity, inclusivity and equity in the music industry?](https://futurumcareers.com/how-can-innovative-ethnomusicology-research-help-foster-diversity-inclusivity-and-equity-in-the-music-industry): Dr Marcia Ostashewski on ethnomusicology research for music industry equity

## Youth Advocacy & Caregiving

- [The wisdom of young carers](https://futurumcareers.com/the-wisdom-of-young-carers): Young Caregiver Council of Canada advocates for young carers and peer support

## STEM Education & Discovery

- [The 2026 Scientix® STEM Discovery Campaign is here!](https://futurumcareers.com/the-2026-scientix-stem-discovery-campaign-is-here): Scientix and NBS Academy launch 2026 STEM Discovery Campaign for educators
